# Upstream source

The `web/` directory is based on
[`basketikun/infinite-canvas`](https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas)
commit `e6d0911e9d509d00150eaab02f9ca05be94ffc46` (`v0.19.0`).

The upstream author is basketikun. See `LICENSE` for the MIT terms and retain
the original author attribution when distributing modified versions.

Local changes to this snapshot are limited to the PicPocket extension build,
MV3 compatibility, and integration with PicPocket data. Compare against the
pinned commit before pulling further upstream updates.
